claims: The Artemis II mission is estimated to cost approximately $4.1 billion for the single launch.
The approximately $4.1 billion figure covers the operation of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft for the crewed lunar flyby.
The total, multi-year Artemis program has cost over $90 billion.
The NASA Inspector General estimated each of the first four Artemis missions costs around $4.1 to $4.2 billion.
The SLS rocket and Orion capsule cost over $44 billion to develop.
The overall Artemis program, running from 2012–2025, is estimated at roughly $93 billion.
The SLS rocket has run billions over its initial budget
